item.title: GitHub Runner 1.3.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • fix: delete a docker runner's work folder off the main thread (#62) by @SaschaHenning in https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/pull/64
  • fix: keep settings-load failures out of the real app.log during tests (#61) by @SaschaHenning in https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/pull/66
  • fix: delete a native runner's folder off the main thread (#65) by @SaschaHenning in https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/pull/67
  • feat: register all lost runners of a scope again in one step (#63) by @SaschaHenning in https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/pull/68

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/compare/v1.2.9...v1.3.0
